summary: NFT Ltd, a Hong Kong-domiciled foreign private issuer in finance services/crypto assets, furnished a routine Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements for the period ended June 30, 2026, filed September 30, 2026. The excerpt consists of XBRL context tags covering Class A and Class B shares, warrants issued around March 2026 and May 2026, share-based measurement inputs, tax rates for Hong Kong subsidiaries, and subsidiary references including Metaverse Digital Payment Co Limited and Solarlink Group Inc. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural event is disclosed; this is an ordinary periodic report, not a special situation.
